name: Sanitation Standard Operating Procedures (SSOP)
search_intent: Food manufacturers, catering supervisors, and hygiene managers looking for a comprehensive Sanitation Standard Operating Procedures (SSOP) manual and digital checklist covering pre-operational sanitation, operational cleaning, chemical concentrations, contact times, and verification sign-offs.

competitors.title: SSOP Template & Daily Cleaning Log | FoodDocs
competitors.weaknesses: Paywalled behind software trial, requires card or business email.

competitors.title: SSOP Checklists & Templates | SafetyCulture
competitors.weaknesses: Gated mobile app download, zero public browser utility without account.

competitors.title: Sanitation SOP Regulatory Guide | USDA FSIS
competitors.weaknesses: Extremely dense, 50-page complex PDF, unsuitable for catering kitchens.

competitors.title: Cleaning Schedules for Catering | High Speed Training
competitors.weaknesses: Static article promoting online courses, lacks operational digital logging tool.

competitors.title: Hygiene & Sanitation Management | Campden BRI
competitors.weaknesses: Commercial consultancy brochure, no free templates or tools.

gap_analysis.what_they_have: Paywalled SaaS apps or static regulatory PDFs.
gap_analysis.what_they_lack: An ungated, interactive digital SSOP checklist with pre-operational inspection, 5-stage cleaning steps, BS EN 1276 chemical dilution verification, and digital sign-off.
gap_analysis.what_we_offer: Digital checklist tool with 8 dedicated SSOP tasks, real-time status checkboxes, corrective notes, CSV export, and printable audit sheet.
